# A17-S26: Correspondence

Correspondence extract. [████] marks redaction; […] marks omission.

[…]

Hi [████] - have also just cc’ed [████] because there is good news regarding getting the global debate about Life with Artificials kicked off.

Looking forward to talking with you ([████]) today. Have been moving pieces around in the attachment for a while, and think it’s a good and realistic plan now.

However, I am excited to see if the scene will be completely different after tomorrow. I've had a blazing phone the last couple of days, and most importantly, tomorrow a video interview with an accompanying article will be released through Agence France Presse. It is one of the world's three largest news agencies, and they distribute the story to over a thousand media outlets in many, many countries. As far as I understand, it will be sent out in English, French, Spanish, German, Portuguese, and Arabic, counting several hundred million potential recipients. It could be absolutely wild!

In addition, I was interviewed by Le Figaro yesterday, which is one of France's oldest and most important newspapers. France is generally Europe's frontline for artificial intelligence, and that can probably make quite a difference. They also have a French AI expert comment, which will be exciting to follow.

So with reservations for changes now that we are really starting the global debate about Life with Artificials, here are suggestions that propose a strategy regarding both activities, art production funds, and of course the expected parliamentary election in the fall (AI election posters!!).

All the best, [████]
